Message:
A pack o’ wolves was eatin’
an offerin’ to the Great Dragon God.

But, instead o’ fightin’ ’em off,
all I could do was
hide in a cave nearby...

I always do this...!
Whenever somethin’ bad happens,
I get so scared,
my body refuses to move...

I’m supposed to be
a priestess servin’
the Great Dragon God, too...
which makes me
even more pathetic...!

Great Dragon God...
Please, find it in yer heart
to forgive me for
bein’ so worthless...!

Leave this mountain...?!
D-Does that mean
I’m bein’ thrown out?!

Th-The Great Dragon God
must be real mad at me...!
